    Rays of composites #

    In a category with a well-defined BGRS ray product and Artinian endomorphism rings, the ray of a nonzero composite f ≫ g is a left multiple of the ray of g and a right multiple of the ray of f: the composite can be rewritten with a non-special pair (RayCat.unitRay_comp_eq_left, RayCat.unitRay_comp_eq_right).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_nonspecial_right_of_comp {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] {X Y Z : C} [IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) (g₀ : Y ⟶ Z) (hf : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (g : Y ⟶ Z), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g₀ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g ∧ ¬IsBGRSSpecialZero f g

    The mirror of exists_nonspecial_middle_factor_of_comp: a nonzero composite has a non-special factorization with the same left factor.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.unitRay_comp_eq_left {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {X Y Z : C} [IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hfg : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (ρ : { as := X } ⟶ { as := Y }), unitRay (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρ (unitRay g)

    The ray of a composite is a left multiple of the ray of the second factor.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.unitRay_comp_eq_right {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {X Y Z : C} [IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hfg : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (ρ : { as := Y } ⟶ { as := Z }), unitRay (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (unitRay f) ρ

    The ray of a composite is a right multiple of the ray of the first factor.
